verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance is an API-first product. Its public developer docs cover endpoints for account balance, ACH details, account owner verification, transaction data and data refresh, plus documented token-based authentication, an unlimited sandbox (Test Drive) and an OpenAPI spec repository on GitHub for generating client libraries. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
